description: Bosco Gurin is the Walser village at about 1500 metres in Ticino, a lane of dark timber houses on stone bases and a small stone church. The roofs are bare under a dry late-September night. This replaces the Airolo and Gotthard approach, already published. The Open-Meteo model is mainly clear and cool, about 11°C, with cloud cover under one-tenth, dry air, a fresh wind, and no precipitation, and the sun is below the horizon.
